title: Key art: first light
prompt: Key art for a historical drama. A nineteen-year-old Greek jar-maker and his old bearded father sit on a doorstep in a narrow ancient street at dawn, seen from behind and slightly to the side; the street and roofs still in cold blue shadow; a single shaft of warm gold light falls on them from something enormous and unseen above frame; long shadow of a colossal figure lies across the far rooftops. Quiet, intimate, epic by implication.

title: The grid city
prompt: Painterly wide landscape: the Hellenistic city of Rhodes seen from its hillside acropolis in late afternoon, a perfect orthogonal grid of plastered houses with terracotta roofs running down to two harbours full of ships, city walls along the coast, dark blue sea, blue mountains of Asia Minor across the strait, a stadium in the foreground; far in the haze a tall bronze figure is only a small glint among the roofs.

title: The kilns
prompt: Morning outside the city walls: an amphora workshop, domed brick kilns breathing smoke, hundreds of tall unfired wine jars drying in rows, a bare-chested old workman and a young man carrying jars, dust and gold light, documentary realism.

title: The great harbour
prompt: Midday in a teeming ancient Greek commercial harbour: broad Egyptian grain ships moored three deep along stone moles, square sails, porters with sacks, tax-farmers with a bronze balance, stacked amphorae, glittering chaff in hard light, a thin warship with a bronze ram gliding in the background.

title: The club at night
prompt: Night interior, warm lamplight: a dining club of a dozen men of different origins reclining on couches in a modest Greek house, a large painted mixing bowl, fish on a clay brazier, faces half in shadow, laughter, painterly chiaroscuro like a Caravaggio lit only by oil lamps.

title: The pedestal
prompt: Night, moonlight: a small young man stands with one palm on a towering white marble pedestal carved with a Greek inscription; the top of the frame shows only the edge of colossal bronze toes disappearing into a sky full of stars; awe, solitude, intimacy.

title: Somebody always reads them
prompt: Present day macro photograph: blue-gloved archaeologist's fingers holding a broken terracotta amphora handle just lifted from dry soil; its small stamped sun-face impression is slightly crooked; soft daylight, shallow depth of field.
